description: Active public large-project fixtures for primary objective token-saving experiments. GitHub metadata was fetched via the GitHub REST API on 2026-07-01; commits were pinned with git ls-remote on 2026-07-01.

selection_policy.include: Large, active, public repositories with substantial software-engineering task surfaces and feasible subsystem-scoped verification.
selection_policy.exclude: User-owned/local personal projects, toy fixtures, archived repositories, and projects where no bounded verifier can be frozen.
selection_policy.promotion_required: Clone/pin a clean snapshot, freeze one task prompt, freeze setup/reset/verifier commands, and record blocker-free raw artifact paths before marking primary-objective.
selection_policy.active_fixture_count: Current qualified active fixture remains Terraform for Go. Target replacement matrix adds OrchardCore as the large C# candidate and demotes Django from the future default matrix once a five-task C# workflow is qualified.
selection_policy.target_matrix: large C# OrchardCore plus large Go Terraform; avoid foundational/high-popularity platform projects such as ASP.NET Core/runtime/Roslyn for the C# slot.

candidates.why: Large Go CLI/infrastructure codebase with typed compiler/test feedback; more tractable than Kubernetes while still complex enough for retrieval and stack tests.
candidates.setup_policy: Clone a pinned commit and use Go test/build commands for a frozen package subset.
candidates.verifier_policy: Use go test on the edited package and adjacent packages; record skipped integration requirements explicitly.
candidates.selected_reason: First-wave fixture: large public project with bounded subsystem verifier suitable for repeated baseline/treatment runs.

candidates.role: target large C# replacement fixture candidate
candidates.why: Large active C# CMS/application framework with realistic module, routing, content, and service-layer task surfaces while avoiding foundational Microsoft platform repositories such as ASP.NET Core, runtime, or Roslyn.
candidates.setup_policy: Install a pinned .NET SDK, clone a pinned commit, restore only the bounded solution/project subset needed for each task, and freeze exact build/test commands before qualification.
candidates.verifier_policy: Use bounded dotnet test selectors on edited OrchardCore modules plus build checks for touched projects; do not run the full solution for every replicate unless the task requires it.
candidates.selected_reason: Preferred large C# slot for the target matrix: substantial but not foundational, active, and likely to support bounded real maintenance tasks.
